name: Changes
description: Shows what changed in each pane's git repo: a badge with the counts, a sidebar with the changed files as a tree, and their diffs, uncommitted or on the whole branch.

mcpTools.name: changed_files
mcpTools.description: Lists the files changed in the git repo containing a folder, with each file's status (M modified, A added, D deleted, R renamed, ? untracked) and added and removed line counts. `against` is "uncommitted" (the working tree, staged and untracked included, against HEAD; the default) or "branch" (everything since this branch left the default branch). Read-only.

cwd.description: An absolute path to a folder inside the repo.
